contract: EduAutis Sensory-Safe Inclusive Design Direction Contract (ui-design-contract.md). Target audience: autistic students (calm, predictable, large targets, zero emoji) and teachers/educators (SaaS-grade clean data tables, zero emoji, calm contrast WCAG AA/AAA).

accessibility.evidence: All color token pairs verified with scripts/check-contrast.mjs passing WCAG AA (13.93:1) and AAA (21:1). Skip-link present. Keyboard focus rings defined with :focus-visible. Student touch targets exceed minimum 48px/64px.

responsive.evidence: Tested mobile viewport 390x844 and desktop 1440x900. Layout grid adjusts seamlessly from single column on mobile to 2/3 columns on desktop. No horizontal overflow (overflow-x: hidden layout guard).

loading.evidence: Audio and game engine states provide calm loading indicators without flickering or aggressive animations.

empty.evidence: Empty material and quiz states display dedicated calm empty-state cards with polite recovery navigation.

error.evidence: Error states (403, 404, 500, and auth errors) render clean, structured error cards with recovery buttons.

partial.reason: Views display complete atomic cards or paginate via standard full-page dataset pagination.

success.evidence: Attendance recorded, quiz finished, and settings saved display polite confirmation feedback bars.

permission.evidence: RoleMiddleware guards enforce 403 screen with safe return to home link.

renderedEvidence.observation: Student login view renders clean monogram S, tactile digital numpad, and high-contrast input without any emoji.
Role select view renders two distinct cards for Student and Teacher with zero emojis, clean typographic badges, and subtle hover elevation.
